chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan both narrated to me from al-Husayn ibn Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Yusuf al-Kunasi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When you go to the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), go to the Euphrates and perform Ghusl near his grave.

key_terms.الْفُرَات: The Euphrates River, a major river in Iraq near Karbala.
key_terms.قَبْرَ الْحُسَيْنِ: The grave of Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon him).

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended ritual purification before visiting the grave of Imam Husayn?
ai.summary: This hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat* highlights the spiritual purification associated with visiting the shrine of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.), linking the physical act of bathing in the Euphrates to the sanctity of the grave's proximity. In Shia tradition, this ritual emphasizes the connection between the martyr's sacrifice and the natural elements of Karbala, serving as a preparatory step to enter the spiritual presence of the Imam with both bodily and spiritual cleanliness.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 8. My father and Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan both narrated to me from Ḥusain ibn Ḥasan ibn Abān, from Ḥusain ibn Sa’īd, from Faďālah ibn Ayyūb, from Yūsuf Al-Kunāsi, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
When you go to the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.), go to the part of the Euphrates (River) closest to his grave and perform Ghusl with its water.
